opening.argument: The video actively promotes an external route to obtain Robux, directing viewers to a pinned link and presenting the process as attainable: “the link to it is going to be in the pinned comment.” It supplies a promotional code promising an extra reward and expressly tells viewers that surveys can earn additional Robux on the website. The webpage reinforces that promotional presentation with a visible “+41 ROBUX” indicator. Although the separate in-game generator is ultimately criticized, that conclusion does not remove the video’s simultaneous promotion of the survey-based earning flow, including the prospect of obtaining Robux through the linked site. The promotional solicitation and low-barrier reward promise are the central basis for the position taken here.
